scripts.desktop:dev: node scripts/build-desktop-preload.mjs && cross-env DSP_DESKTOP_DEV_URL=http://127.0.0.1:4318 DSP_DESKTOP_EDITION=performance electron .
scripts.desktop:pack: npm run build:desktop && node desktop/pack.cjs pack
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run build:desktop && node desktop/pack.cjs dist
scripts.desktop:performance:pack: npm run build:desktop && cross-env DSP_DESKTOP_EDITION=performance node desktop/pack.cjs pack
scripts.desktop:performance:dist: npm run build:desktop && cross-env DSP_DESKTOP_EDITION=performance node desktop/pack.cjs dist
scripts.desktop:release: node scripts/verify-desktop-signing-env.mjs && npm run build:desktop && node desktop/pack.cjs release
scripts.android:sync: npm run build:android && cap sync android && node scripts/sync-native-versions.mjs
scripts.android:debug: cross-env DSP_ANDROID_DEBUG=1 npm run android:sync && android\gradlew.bat -p android assembleDebug
scripts.android:release:unsigned: npm run android:sync && android\gradlew.bat -p android bundleRelease assembleRelease
